strongest_angle: Examining the legendary career and life of Sir Patrick Stewart, from his classical roots in the Royal Shakespeare Company to his iconic roles as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek and Professor X in X-Men, following his passing at age 86.

key_facts.fact: Sir Patrick Stewart died at the age of 86 at his home in Los Angeles on Wednesday after suffering with Alzheimer's Disease and Lewy Body Dementia.
Sir Patrick Stewart depicted Captain Jean-Luc Picard in more than 170 episodes of the hit series Star Trek.
In 1966, Sir Patrick Stewart became a member of the Royal Shakespeare Company in the United Kingdom.
Sir Patrick Stewart was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II for his services to drama in the year 2010.

numbers.label: Year of knighthood by Queen Elizabeth II

quotes.text: Sir Ian McKellen has led tributes to Sir Patrick Stewart following his death at the age of 86, calling him "the most respected and beloved actor of his generation".
quotes.speaker: Jamie Whitehead
